title: A customer question about Plans and Pricing

question.author: member_027
question.body: I need a short answer about plans and pricing. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: Plan changes take effect at the start of the next billing cycle; upgrades apply immediately with prorated charges. CloudBox offers four plans. Free: 10 GB for individuals. Plus: 2 TB for $9.99 per month. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
